narr: A deep 500 MB low over the lower Mississippi Valley, and associated surface low that was nearly stationary beneath it, produced a humid tropical air mass over the area. Convection anchored over the southern Plateau and produced flash flooding in areas that flooded just a few weeks earlier.
ev: Numerous roads closed across the county. Evacuations underway along Branch Road. A CoCoRAHS site reported 6.25 inches of rain between noon and midnight 6 NNW of Dunlap. This is roughly the same area impacted by flooding a few weeks ago.
lsr: DISPATCH REPORTS NUMEROUS ROADS CLOSED ACROSS THE COUNTY. EVACUATIONS UNDER WAY ALONG BRANCH RD.
